concepts.title: Singular directions
concepts.meaning: Orthogonal directions show which input variations survive a linear transformation most strongly.
concepts.brief: Map a round input cloud into an elongated output cloud; mark its orthogonal principal directions and unequal stretch factors.
pitfalls: Keep principal directions orthogonal and distinguish input from output space.

concepts.title: Regression residual
concepts.meaning: A residual is the vertical gap between an observed value and its fitted prediction at the same input.
concepts.brief: Place a fitted line beside observed points and animate one vertical residual from the line to its matching observation.
pitfalls: Measure residuals along the response axis at the same input coordinate.

concepts.title: Sigmoid threshold
concepts.meaning: A probability threshold converts a logistic model score into a class decision.
concepts.brief: Plot a sigmoid probability curve against a horizontal decision threshold, then mark where an example crosses it.
pitfalls: Keep the output probability scale bounded between zero and one.

concepts.title: Classification boundary
concepts.meaning: A decision boundary separates regions where a classifier predicts different classes.
concepts.brief: Show two labeled point groups separated by a linear boundary in a feature plane; keep points near the margin visible.
pitfalls: Do not present a boundary as a probability calibration curve.

concepts.title: Cross-validation folds
concepts.meaning: Held-out folds rotate so each partition measures generalization while the others train the model.
concepts.brief: Draw aligned data folds and rotate the held-out fold while training uses the remaining partitions.
pitfalls: Each example belongs to one fold per split; the held-out fold changes across rounds.

concepts.title: Causal intervention
concepts.meaning: An intervention sets a treatment value and removes its usual incoming causes from the causal graph.
concepts.brief: Contrast an observed incoming causal edge with a direct intervention marker on treatment, then preserve downstream effects.
pitfalls: Separate intervention from conditioning on an observed value.

concepts.title: Neuron signal
concepts.meaning: A neuron combines weighted inputs, applies an activation function, and sends an output signal.
concepts.brief: Route input signals into a neuron, then show its activated output as one outgoing signal.
pitfalls: Keep weighted input, activation, and output stages distinct.

concepts.title: Optimizer trajectory
concepts.meaning: Momentum combines a gradient with running velocity that carries updates through a curved loss surface.
concepts.brief: Trace an optimizer through elongated loss contours; compare direct gradient steps with a momentum path toward a minimum.
pitfalls: Keep contour geometry and trajectory direction consistent with descent.

concepts.title: Transformer block
concepts.meaning: A transformer block combines attention and a feed-forward layer with residual paths.
concepts.brief: Show token state passing through attention and feed-forward sublayers while residual routes preserve the incoming representation.
pitfalls: Keep attention and feed-forward operations sequential within one block.

concepts.title: Next-token logits
concepts.meaning: Logits score candidate next tokens before softmax converts them into probabilities.
concepts.brief: Show signed candidate scores from the final hidden state and highlight the largest logit before probability normalization.
pitfalls: Keep logits distinct from normalized probabilities.

concepts.title: Contrastive pair
concepts.meaning: Contrastive learning pulls matching examples together in embedding space and separates mismatched examples.
concepts.brief: Place an anchor near its positive pair and far from negatives; animate positive attraction and negative repulsion.
pitfalls: Distance encodes embedding similarity, not a causal relationship.

concepts.title: Scaling frontier
concepts.meaning: A scaling frontier compares achievable model quality with compute and exposes diminishing returns.
concepts.brief: Plot quality against compute on a log-scaled axis; mark the frontier knee and compare feasible training choices.
pitfalls: Label compute and avoid implying quality rises linearly forever.

concepts.title: Assistant loss mask
concepts.meaning: Supervised fine-tuning can score assistant targets while keeping user prompts as conditioning context.
concepts.brief: Color prompt tokens separately from assistant targets and place loss markers only beneath assistant targets.
pitfalls: A loss mask controls target positions; it does not remove prompt context.

concepts.title: Online softmax
concepts.meaning: Online softmax updates a running maximum and normalizer as attention scores arrive tile by tile.
concepts.brief: Stream score tiles into a running maximum and rescaled normalizer so the full score matrix need not be stored.
pitfalls: Show rescaling of earlier contributions when the running maximum changes.

concepts.title: Speculative draft and verify
concepts.meaning: A draft model proposes several tokens that a larger model verifies in one parallel pass.
concepts.brief: Show draft tokens entering verification, then separate accepted tokens from the first rejected token and correction.
pitfalls: Verification uses the target model distribution; rejection can resample a corrected token.

concepts.title: Schema automaton
concepts.meaning: A schema automaton tracks valid output states and blocks tokens that cannot lead to a valid structure.
concepts.brief: Trace token choices through a state machine; valid transitions reach acceptance while invalid prefixes terminate.
pitfalls: The schema constrains structure; the model still chooses among allowed continuations.

concepts.title: Causal attention mask
concepts.meaning: A causal mask lets each position attend to itself and earlier positions while blocking future tokens.
concepts.brief: Reveal a lower-triangular attention mask aligned to token order; each row reads only its prefix.
pitfalls: The diagonal is visible because a position may attend to itself.

concepts.title: Training-data mixture
concepts.meaning: A training mixture assigns sampling weights to datasets before examples enter the training stream.
concepts.brief: Show source datasets contributing at different rates to one sampled training stream; expose weights as proportions.
pitfalls: Mixture weights are not the same as raw dataset sizes.

concepts.title: Sequence packing
concepts.meaning: Packing short training sequences into one block reduces padding while keeping boundaries visible.
concepts.brief: Compare padded sequences with a packed block that places several examples contiguously and marks boundaries.
pitfalls: Packing must preserve sequence boundaries and attention/loss semantics.

concepts.title: FlashAttention tile dataflow
concepts.meaning: FlashAttention reuses query, key, and value tiles in fast memory to reduce high-bandwidth memory traffic.
concepts.brief: Move compact query, key, and value tiles through on-chip memory while updating output state without writing a full attention matrix.
pitfalls: Memory traffic and score-matrix materialization are the focus.

concepts.title: Tensor shard
concepts.meaning: Tensor parallelism partitions a weight matrix across devices and combines partial results at communication boundaries.
concepts.brief: Split one weight matrix into device-owned shards, show local computation, and mark where partial results communicate.
pitfalls: Distinguish tensor shards from replicated data-parallel copies.
